descriptionAdvanced.en: Zibo, located in the heart of Shandong Province, is a city defined by its profound historical significance and robust industrial foundation. As the ancient capital of the State of Qi during the Warring States period, Zibo served as a premier cultural and political hub for centuries. The city is internationally recognized by FIFA as the official birthplace of Cuju, an ancient precursor to modern soccer. Additionally, Zibo maintains a prestigious tradition in ceramics and glassware production that remains a cornerstone of its identity today. In the modern era, the city has transformed into a vital center for the petrochemical and heavy machinery industries. Culturally, Zibo offers a unique window into classical Chinese literature as the home of the renowned author Pu Songling. Zibo successfully balances its rich legacy as an ancient metropolis with its contemporary role as a leading industrial node in eastern China.

en: Zibo served as the capital of the State of Qi for more than 800 years in ancient times.
In 2004, FIFA officially designated Zibo as the historical birthplace of soccer.
The city is home to China's largest ceramics museum, showcasing over 30,000 items.
Pu Songling, the author of 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio,' was born here in 1640.
Zibo is a major center for the art of snuff bottle painting, dating back to the Tang Dynasty.
The city is a significant national hub for petrochemical refining and chemical manufacturing.
